options.description: Command-line options passed to btcheck(1) on each invocation; e.g. ['-l', '-n', '-v']. Valid values are: -h, -V, -v, -q, -n, -z, -i, -l.

working_directory.description: Directory in which btcheck performs data checking when the torrent's info directory is absent or unreadable.

data_prefix.description: Optional path prefix prepended to torrent's declared data directory to support chroot or containerized setups.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds allowed per file for hash computation. Set to 0 to disable timeout.
